description: Compare two SQLite or D1 databases and return their schema and row-count differences as JSON. Works across any combination of local files, D1, and Turso — e.g. diff a local migration target against a live D1 database. Read-only.

new.description: Changed ('after') source — Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

old.description: Baseline ('before') source — Database source: a local file path (./app.db), a Cloudflare D1 DSN (d1://DB_ID when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN+CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID are set, or d1://TOKEN@ACCOUNT_ID/DB_ID), or a Turso DSN (turso://TOKEN@ORG/DB).

name: litescope_diff

data_changes.description: Per-table row-count differences (present when data differs).

title: Diff two databases
